character.name: Dorcas Nettlebed
character.description: A small, square figure in an apron stiff with official starch, carrying a bag that clinks in an administrative way. Dorcas is a Professional Mourner, Between Engagements and is keeping in practice and will be sad about anything, on request.

npc.narrative: You reach the Upper Common on the Wrong Side as the sera settles, the cielo clear and nothing in it to blame. Dorcas Nettlebed sits on a panchina with a nero ombrello, which has attended molti funerali and is not saying which. Her quaderno counts the people on the strada, and the matita gives a piccolo twitch.
npc.native: Buonasera! Io sono felice stasera, perché tu sei la terza persona che passa. Di solito il cielo mi delude, ma oggi è chiaro. Come stai tu?
npc.translation: Good evening! I am happy this evening, because you are the third person to pass. Usually the sky lets me down, but today it is clear. How are you?

player: Buonasera! Sto bene, anche io sono felice oggi perché ho finito il lavoro presto.

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely answer! You greeted Dorcas, said how you are, and shared that you are happy today and why, all in good Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: You told Dorcas you are happy today in Italian, and "sono felice" is exactly right.

npc.narrative: Dorcas lets out a sospiro that has been waiting by the porta all sera. Above the strada the stelle are out, and she regards them like an overdue creditor. She counts on her dita, reaches tre, and is quietly pleased the total is still dispari.
npc.native: Che bello, finisci il lavoro presto! Io invece sono un po' triste stasera. Non so che succede, ma il cielo è bello e nessuno ha un funerale. Che cosa fai tu quando finisci presto?
npc.translation: How nice, you finish work early! I, on the other hand, am a little sad this evening. I do not know what is happening, but the sky is lovely and nobody has a funeral. What do you do when you finish early?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely, you asked Dorcas what is wrong and even added a natural follow-up question about why she is sad. Next, try showing her some sympathy.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you asked Dorcas what is wrong in Italian.

openObjectives.prompt: Tell Dorcas that you understand, or that you are very sorry, using Italian.

npc.narrative: Dorcas sits on the low muro by the strada, her scialle nero folded in her lap like a spare. Above her the cielo is full of stelle, and not one of them has the decency to look sorry. She nods at you, grata, the way one nods at a parcel that has reached the right casa.
npc.native: Grazie, sei gentile! Sono triste perché stasera nessuno ha un funerale, e io non lavoro. Di solito dico alla gente: ti capisco. Ma stasera nessuno parla con me, solo tu. Che cosa fai tu quando sei triste?
npc.translation: Thank you, you are kind! I am sad because tonight nobody has a funeral, and I am not working. Usually I say to people: I understand you. But tonight nobody talks to me, only you. What do you do when you are sad?

player: Ti capisco, mi dispiace molto. Quando sono triste mangio il gelato e chiamo mia sorella.

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely, kind reply! You comforted Dorcas and told her what you do when you are sad, all in clear Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done: "Ti capisco, mi dispiace molto" tells Dorcas you understand and are sorry.

npc.narrative: The notte is clear, and the stelle stand over the strada like guests who arrived early and will not say so. Dorcas Nettlebed counts on her dita, reaches tre, and looks pleased about it. Her cappello nero tips toward you, piano, as if sorrow were something you had handed over.
npc.native: Grazie, tu mi capisci davvero! Il gelato è una buona idea, e anche tua sorella è una buona idea. Io stasera non ho il gelato, ma ho le stelle, e sono tre persone con te. Che gusto di gelato mangi tu?
npc.translation: Thank you, you really understand me! Ice cream is a good idea, and your sister is a good idea too. Tonight I have no ice cream, but I have the stars, and with you that makes three people. What flavour of ice cream do you eat?

player: Mi piace il gelato al pistacchio! Ma chi sono le tre persone? Io, tu e...?

npc.narrative: Dorcas counts on her dita, then counts again, in case the numero has changed. Above the strada the stelle are out, and the notte is perfectly quieta. Somewhere a capra disagrees with something.
npc.native: Il pistacchio è un gusto serio, bravo! Le tre persone sono un uomo con un carro, una signora con una capra e tu. Tre è un numero dispari, e per questo sono felice. Dove mangi tu il gelato di solito?
npc.translation: Pistachio is a serious flavour, well done! The three people are a man with a cart, a lady with a goat and you. Three is an odd number, and that is why I am happy. Where do you usually eat ice cream?

player: Di solito in centro, vicino alla piazza. Ma prima eri triste e adesso sei felice? Sei strana, Dorcas!

npc.narrative: Dorcas lifts her mento at the cielo, where the stelle are out and, for once, behaving. She counts you on her dita with a small frown, the way a woman checks a bill. Beyond the piazza a vecchia lanterna flickers, and nobody looks at it.
npc.native: Sì, sono strana, e sono contenta! Prima ero triste perché nessuno aveva un funerale, ma adesso siamo tre, e tre è un numero dispari. Una brava professionista è triste e felice nella stessa sera. Chi incontri tu in piazza quando mangi il gelato?
npc.translation: Yes, I am strange, and I am glad! Earlier I was sad because nobody had a funeral, but now we are three, and three is an odd number. A good professional is sad and happy in the same evening. Whom do you meet in the square when you eat ice cream?

player: Incontro i miei amici, a volte. Senti, tu piangi davvero ai funerali? È difficile piangere per una persona che non conosci?

npc.narrative: Dorcas puts a mano on her cuore, like someone checking a pocket for a fazzoletto she is fairly sure she brought. Above you the stelle are all out, and she counts them under her breath, piano, in case the total turns out to be even. The notte, at least, has not let her down yet.
npc.native: Sì, piango davvero, è il mio lavoro! Non è difficile: penso al cielo, che stasera è bello e mi delude lo stesso. Una volta ho pianto per tre ore per un signore che non conoscevo, e la famiglia era molto contenta. Tu hai pianto qualche volta per una persona che non conoscevi?
npc.translation: Yes, I really cry, it is my job! It is not difficult: I think of the sky, which tonight is beautiful and disappoints me all the same. Once I cried for three hours for a gentleman I did not know, and the family was very pleased. Have you ever cried for a person you did not know?
